subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw accept this provider-managed Claude/GLM bridge as a bundled, security-owned product surface, or require the work to ship as an external plugin/ClawHub integration using existing extension seams?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds a new executable provider runtime, credential-forwarding behavior, persistent session handling, and a contributor-scoped package dependency; choosing its permanent owner and supported distribution model cannot be resolved mechanically.

options.title: Route it to an external plugin
options.body: Keep core generic and publish the Claude/GLM bridge as independently owned plugin packages with their own dependency, install, update, and support lifecycle.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed bundled design
options.body: Approve a staged design only after OpenClaw adopts or secops-approves the bridge package and the implementation uses canonical state storage and reviewed SDK seams.

options.title: Decline this harness direction
options.body: Retain existing Anthropic, Claude CLI, and ACP paths and close the implementation proposal after documenting the preferred supported route.

recommendation.title: Route it to an external plugin
recommendation.body: Keep core generic and publish the Claude/GLM bridge as independently owned plugin packages with their own dependency, install, update, and support lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is product and ownership direction rather than a mechanical patch detail.
